content.text:
I submitted index 4 (Sb fraction 0.31) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, 0.0242%. I used all 5 EQE measurements and 2 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.20 | 0.0140 |
| **4** | **0.31** | **0.0242** |
| 6 | 0.365 | 0.0189 |
| 14 | 0.51 | 0.0096 |
| 23 | 0.68 | 0.0079 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE drops on both sides of 0.31 and is much lower at higher Sb fractions. The best composition on the line is probably somewhere between 0.20 and 0.365 Sb. Index 3 (0.26) and index 5 (0.358) were never measured, so one of them could be slightly better than index 4.
- **Structure (XRD):** The strongest peaks at index 4 point to a single pyrochlore-like phase. I only guessed that it's Pb₂Sb₂O₇ from the peak pattern; I didn't compare it against simulated patterns. Index 0 (Sb 0.17) shows the same pattern plus extra peaks from a second phase that I didn't identify.

The EQE values are all very small (hundredths of a percent). I haven't judged whether those size differences are larger than measurement noise, so the ranking near the top is less certain than it looks.
